your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Light blues are cheap, cheap to build on, and give a good return. Buy it early and aim to complete the set.
Orange is the best group on the board, since it gets hit most often after jail. I have plenty of cash at $1380. Plan: complete orange, and keep light blue as a backup option.

It's too early to trade, since nobody has a set worth swapping for yet. I'm holding cash at $1200. My targets are orange and light blue. p4 has Oriental, so I may be able to make a light blue deal later.

Utility is a weak earner, but I have $1214 and it's early. It's cheap trade fodder and blocks others. Main goals are still orange (p4 has St James) and light blue (p4 has Oriental), so p4 is my key trade partner later.
Orange is my main goal. If I get St James, I hold 2 of the 3 oranges and only need New York. Paying $60 over list is worth it.

If I sold Connecticut for cash, p4 would have 2 light blues and I'd get nothing toward a set. Swapping it for St James is better for me: orange beats light blue, and I'd only need New York. If p4 refuses the swap, I'll consider their cash offer, but I'd want $280 or more.

Selling Connecticut for cash would give p4 2 light blues with only unowned Vermont left to complete the set. That's too risky, so I'm keeping it as a blocker and trade chip. Plan: watch for New York (unowned) and a chance to get St James later. Cash $1064.

It's too early to trade. Nobody holds 2 of any color besides p4 (orange St James + light blue Oriental, but each needs pieces I hold or the bank holds). Keep $864 cash. Targets: New York and Virginia for orange, Vermont as a light blue blocker.
